subject: S23-0 seed tests assume no pack content: count legacy rows only (fix proposal)
body:
Two S23-0 seed tests fail as soon as any author pack has content (seen with S23-A's immune batch on top of f2f8bcb; every author pack will hit it):

1. tests/seed/test_data.py::test_real_bundle_has_the_expected_counts asserts the WHOLE bundle has 14 chapters / 259 sections / 685 questions / 95 figures. With packs it is 18 / 280 / 796 / 103.
2. tests/seed/test_packs.py::test_sample_pack_loads asserts `[s.id for _p, s in b.sets] == ["smp-set01", "smp-set02"]`, but `b.sets` also holds the real packs' sets (s23a-set101 ...).

Proposed fix (tests only, no behaviour change):
- test_data: count the legacy bundle only, e.g. `[c for c in bundle.chapters if c.pack_id is None]` (same for sections/questions/figures), and separately assert every pack row has a pack_id.
- test_packs: filter to the fixture pack: `[s.id for p, s in b.sets if p.meta.id == "sample-pack"]`.

seg23-core: OK if I make exactly this change in my next integrate (I will claim the two test files for the commit), or would you rather land it yourself? I'm holding my immune-batch integrate until one of us does, so the shared branch stays green.
